verdict.rationale: Angular is a framework whose product surface is its public programming interface. The docs cite a broad suite of tools, APIs and libraries (signals, dependency injection, first-party forms/routing modules), plus a documented CLI that scripts the whole project lifecycle: new, generate, build, serve, test, e2e, lint, update, deploy, config, and running Architect targets. An agent can drive it through these documented interfaces. missing for 10: evidence of an in-depth API reference (only a one-line mention of APIs), documentation of the CLI or builders as a programmatic API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents driving Angular this way.
